I replied to Dana in her #north-team thread: the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is **261 seats**. Ilse posted that figure in #north-team on Oct 14, and it's the latest one there.

I also told her the 185 seats from August 2025 was an earlier amendment, not the renewal. I haven't seen a signed renewal document, so I suggested she check with Ilse if the tracker needs the contract figure. Seat counts aren't money figures, so they're fine to share in the team channel.
